comments.label: Comment by Farib Mahbub 3 weeks ago
comments.text:
GRG Sir is one of the nicest faculty members I have ever seen at NSU. The amount of effort Sir puts in to make sure each and every student understands every topic is unbelievable.
Sir takes 3 quizzes and counts the best 2. He also takes 2 midterms and of course a final. The quizzes are 40 marks and Sir gives 45 minutes but they are easily doable within 30 minutes or less. He takes 100 mark midterms and a 100 mark final but don’t worry every question carries around 10 to 40 marks.
Sir marks every script very leniently. Even if you write something partially wrong Sir still gives partial marks. He doesn’t cut marks for small mistakes and often gives full marks when the answer is correct. Many students get 100/100 in the midterms and final.
You just need to study as Sir says. His class lectures are very very important and everything comes from there. If you attend his classes regularly and follow his lectures properly there is a high chance you can get an A or A minus.
